description: Static object-event sprites composited over existing map-layout previews.
frameSelection: First valid picture-table frame; animation commands are not evaluated.
coordinateAnchor: Sprite centered horizontally on its event tile, with its feet aligned to the tile's bottom edge.
visibilityNote: Source visibility flags are recorded but not evaluated against in-game state.
runtimeGraphicsNote: ID 0 and OBJ_EVENT_GFX_VAR_* entries are skipped because their visible sprites cannot be determined from static map data alone.
